items.question: Trong câu "Continuously from the first baseline until the product is retired", từ "retire" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Continuously from the first baseline until the product is retired", what does "retire" (verb) mean?
options: ngừng sử dụng, cho thôi vận hành
optionsEn: to take out of use permanently
to stop working because of age
items.explanation: retire /rɪˈtaɪər/ (động từ): ngừng sử dụng, cho thôi vận hành. "The product is retired" = sản phẩm bị ngừng vận hành; với con người, retire nghĩa là nghỉ hưu.
items.explanationEn: retire /rɪˈtaɪər/ (verb): to take out of use permanently. "The product is retired" means it is withdrawn from service; for people, retire means to stop working because of age.

items.question: Trong câu "The key point: excellent requirements development without requirements management falls apart within weeks.", từ "fall apart" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The key point: excellent requirements development without requirements management falls apart within weeks.", what does "fall apart" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: fall apart /fɔːl əˈpɑːrt/ (cụm từ): sụp đổ, tan rã. Cụm "fall apart" hay dùng cho kế hoạch, dự án, mối quan hệ khi chúng không còn hoạt động được.
items.explanationEn: fall apart /fɔːl əˈpɑːrt/ (phrase): to collapse or stop working. "Fall apart" is often used for plans, projects or relationships that stop working.

items.question: Trong câu "A common misconception: requirements management is only for waterfall projects.", từ "misconception" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A common misconception: requirements management is only for waterfall projects.", what does "misconception" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: misconception /ˌmɪskənˈsepʃən/ (danh từ): quan niệm sai lầm. Cụm thường gặp: "a common misconception" = một quan niệm sai phổ biến.
items.explanationEn: misconception /ˌmɪskənˈsepʃən/ (noun): a mistaken belief. A common collocation is "a common misconception", a widely held wrong idea.

items.question: Trong câu "They just use lighter mechanisms — a backlog tool instead of a formal change control board.", từ "mechanism" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They just use lighter mechanisms — a backlog tool instead of a formal change control board.", what does "mechanism" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a moving part of a machine
a method or system for doing something
items.explanation: mechanism /ˈmekənɪzəm/ (danh từ): cơ chế, cách thức. "Mechanism" trong quy trình là cách thức để đạt mục tiêu, ví dụ "a lightweight mechanism" = cơ chế gọn nhẹ.
items.explanationEn: mechanism /ˈmekənɪzəm/ (noun): a method or system for doing something. In processes, a mechanism is the way something is achieved, e.g. "a lightweight mechanism".

items.question: Trong câu "Establishing and maintaining baselines — freezing an agreed set of requirements as a reference point.", từ "freeze" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Establishing and maintaining baselines — freezing an agreed set of requirements as a reference point.", what does "freeze" (verb) mean?
options: cố định, không cho thay đổi
optionsEn: to fix so it cannot change
items.explanation: freeze /friːz/ (động từ): cố định, không cho thay đổi. Trong phần mềm, "freeze" là khoá lại: "code freeze", "freeze the requirements".
items.explanationEn: freeze /friːz/ (verb): to fix so it cannot change. In software, freeze means to lock something: "code freeze", "freeze the requirements".

items.question: Trong câu "A baseline is a reviewed and agreed set of requirements, frozen as a reference point for subsequent work.", từ "subsequent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A baseline is a reviewed and agreed set of requirements, frozen as a reference point for subsequent work.", what does "subsequent" (adjective) mean?
options: tiếp theo, diễn ra sau đó
items.explanation: subsequent /ˈsʌbsɪkwənt/ (tính từ): tiếp theo, diễn ra sau đó. "Subsequent" trái nghĩa với "previous"; cụm "subsequent work/releases" = công việc/bản phát hành sau.
items.explanationEn: subsequent /ˈsʌbsɪkwənt/ (adjective): coming after something else. Subsequent is the opposite of previous; common in "subsequent work" or "subsequent releases".

items.question: Trong câu "It means change from this point on must go through a conscious process rather than silently slipping in.", từ "conscious" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It means change from this point on must go through a conscious process rather than silently slipping in.", what does "conscious" (adjective) mean?
options: có chủ ý, có cân nhắc
items.explanation: conscious /ˈkɒnʃəs/ (tính từ): có chủ ý, có cân nhắc. "A conscious decision" = quyết định có chủ ý; ngược với việc thay đổi lặng lẽ không ai biết.
items.explanationEn: conscious /ˈkɒnʃəs/ (adjective): deliberate and aware. "A conscious decision" is one made deliberately, as opposed to something that happens unnoticed.

items.question: Trong câu "It means change from this point on must go through a conscious process rather than silently slipping in.", từ "slip in" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It means change from this point on must go through a conscious process rather than silently slipping in.", what does "slip in" (phrase) mean?
options: lọt vào một cách lén lút
optionsEn: to get in without being noticed
to log in to a system
items.explanation: slip in /slɪp ɪn/ (cụm từ): lọt vào một cách lén lút. "Slip in" diễn tả thứ gì đó lọt vào mà không ai để ý, ví dụ thay đổi lọt vào phạm vi dự án.
items.explanationEn: slip in /slɪp ɪn/ (phrase): to get in without being noticed. "Slip in" describes something entering unnoticed, such as a change creeping into scope.

items.question: Trong câu "They are the basis for estimation — an estimate without a baseline is a promise with no foundation.", từ "estimation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They are the basis for estimation — an estimate without a baseline is a promise with no foundation.", what does "estimation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: estimation /ˌestɪˈmeɪʃən/ (danh từ): sự ước lượng. "Estimation" là quá trình ước lượng; "an estimate" là con số ước lượng cụ thể.
items.explanationEn: estimation /ˌestɪˈmeɪʃən/ (noun): the process of roughly calculating. Estimation is the process; an estimate is the resulting figure.

items.question: Trong câu "They allow measuring volatility — how much has changed since the baseline?", từ "volatility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They allow measuring volatility — how much has changed since the baseline?", what does "volatility" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: volatility /ˌvɒləˈtɪləti/ (danh từ): mức độ biến động. "Requirements volatility" = độ biến động của yêu cầu; cũng dùng cho giá cả: "market volatility".
items.explanationEn: volatility /ˌvɒləˈtɪləti/ (noun): how much something changes. "Requirements volatility" measures how often requirements change; also used for prices, as in "market volatility".

items.question: Trong câu "They are the basis for contracts in relationships with external vendors.", từ "vendor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They are the basis for contracts in relationships with external vendors.", what does "vendor" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: vendor /ˈvendər/ (danh từ): nhà cung cấp. "External vendor" = nhà cung cấp bên ngoài; liên quan: "vendor lock-in" = bị phụ thuộc nhà cung cấp.
items.explanationEn: vendor /ˈvendər/ (noun): a company that supplies something. "External vendor" is an outside supplier; related: "vendor lock-in".

items.question: Trong câu "A unique version identifier so everyone knows which version they are discussing.", từ "identifier" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A unique version identifier so everyone knows which version they are discussing.", what does "identifier" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a name or code that identifies
items.explanation: identifier /aɪˈdentɪfaɪər/ (danh từ): mã định danh. "Unique identifier" = mã định danh duy nhất, giúp tham chiếu chính xác một phiên bản hay một yêu cầu.
items.explanationEn: identifier /aɪˈdentɪfaɪər/ (noun): a name or code that identifies. A "unique identifier" lets you reference exactly one version or requirement.

items.question: Trong câu "A revision history recording: what changed, who changed it, when, and WHY.", từ "revision" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A revision history recording: what changed, who changed it, when, and WHY.", what does "revision" (noun) mean?
options: sự ôn bài trước kỳ thi
sự sửa đổi, bản chỉnh sửa
optionsEn: a change made to a document
items.explanation: revision /rɪˈvɪʒən/ (danh từ): sự sửa đổi, bản chỉnh sửa. "Revision history" = lịch sử chỉnh sửa; trong tiếng Anh-Anh, revision còn có nghĩa ôn bài.
items.explanationEn: revision /rɪˈvɪʒən/ (noun): a change made to a document. "Revision history" is the record of edits; in British English revision also means studying for exams.

items.question: Trong câu "you immediately know whether the requirement is negotiable.", từ "negotiable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "you immediately know whether the requirement is negotiable.", what does "negotiable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: negotiable /nɪˈɡəʊʃiəbl/ (tính từ): có thể thương lượng. "Negotiable" = có thể bàn lại, thay đổi; "non-negotiable" = không thể thương lượng.
items.explanationEn: negotiable /nɪˈɡəʊʃiəbl/ (adjective): open to discussion or change. Negotiable means open to change through discussion; "non-negotiable" means fixed.

items.question: Trong câu "If requirements exist in three places, they will contradict each other within a month.", từ "contradict" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If requirements exist in three places, they will contradict each other within a month.", what does "contradict" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: contradict /ˌkɒntrəˈdɪkt/ (động từ): mâu thuẫn với. "Contradict each other" = mâu thuẫn nhau; danh từ "contradiction" = sự mâu thuẫn.
items.explanationEn: contradict /ˌkɒntrəˈdɪkt/ (verb): to be inconsistent with. "Contradict each other" means to say opposite things; noun: contradiction.

items.question: Trong câu "When clarification or conflict resolution is needed, you know whom to ask", từ "clarification" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When clarification or conflict resolution is needed, you know whom to ask", what does "clarification" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: clarification /ˌklærəfɪˈkeɪʃən/ (danh từ): sự làm rõ. "Ask for clarification" = đề nghị làm rõ; động từ là "clarify".
items.explanationEn: clarification /ˌklærəfɪˈkeɪʃən/ (noun): making something clearer. "Ask for clarification" means to ask for a clearer explanation; verb: clarify.

items.question: Trong câu "Who is accountable for it", từ "accountable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Who is accountable for it", what does "accountable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: accountable /əˈkaʊntəbl/ (tính từ): chịu trách nhiệm giải trình. "Be accountable for something" = chịu trách nhiệm về việc gì; danh từ "accountability".
items.explanationEn: accountable /əˈkaʊntəbl/ (adjective): responsible and required to explain. "Be accountable for something" means you must answer for it; noun: accountability.

items.question: Trong câu "Pick the smallest set of attributes you ACTUALLY use to make decisions, and drop the rest.", từ "attribute" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pick the smallest set of attributes you ACTUALLY use to make decisions, and drop the rest.", what does "attribute" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the act of crediting to someone
items.explanation: attribute /ˈætrɪbjuːt/ (danh từ): thuộc tính, đặc điểm. Danh từ "attribute" /ˈætrɪbjuːt/ = thuộc tính; động từ "attribute to" /əˈtrɪbjuːt/ = quy cho.
items.explanationEn: attribute /ˈætrɪbjuːt/ (noun): a property or characteristic. The noun /ˈætrɪbjuːt/ means a property; the verb "attribute to" /əˈtrɪbjuːt/ means to credit to.

items.question: Trong câu "That creates enormous maintenance cost nobody uses.", từ "enormous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That creates enormous maintenance cost nobody uses.", what does "enormous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: enormous /ɪˈnɔːməs/ (tính từ): rất lớn, khổng lồ. "Enormous" mạnh hơn "big"; hay đi với cost, value, amount.
items.explanationEn: enormous /ɪˈnɔːməs/ (adjective): extremely large. Enormous is stronger than big; it often goes with cost, value or amount.

items.question: Trong câu "Removed, but retained in the system with a reason", từ "retain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Removed, but retained in the system with a reason", what does "retain" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to keep or continue to hold
items.explanation: retain /rɪˈteɪn/ (động từ): giữ lại, lưu giữ. "Retain data/records" = lưu giữ dữ liệu; danh từ "retention" như "data retention policy".
items.explanationEn: retain /rɪˈteɪn/ (verb): to keep or continue to hold. "Retain data" means to keep it; noun: retention, as in "data retention policy".

items.question: Trong câu "Why NOT delete a removed requirement outright: rejected ideas have a way of coming back.", từ "outright" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why NOT delete a removed requirement outright: rejected ideas have a way of coming back.", what does "outright" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: outright /ˌaʊtˈraɪt/ (trạng từ): hoàn toàn, dứt khoát ngay. "Delete/reject something outright" = xoá/bác bỏ hoàn toàn ngay lập tức, không giữ lại gì.
items.explanationEn: outright /ˌaʊtˈraɪt/ (adverb): completely and immediately. "Reject something outright" means to reject it completely and at once.

items.question: Trong câu "The status distribution gives you a meaningful picture of progress", từ "distribution" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The status distribution gives you a meaningful picture of progress", what does "distribution" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: how things are spread across groups
items.explanation: distribution /ˌdɪstrɪˈbjuːʃən/ (danh từ): sự phân bố. "Status distribution" = cách số yêu cầu phân bố theo từng trạng thái.
items.explanationEn: distribution /ˌdɪstrɪˈbjuːʃən/ (noun): how things are spread across groups. "Status distribution" is how requirements are spread across statuses.

items.question: Trong câu "an enormous unseen mass of testing and defect fixing lies ahead.", từ "defect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "an enormous unseen mass of testing and defect fixing lies ahead.", what does "defect" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: defect /ˈdiːfekt/ (danh từ): lỗi, khiếm khuyết. Trong kiểm thử, "defect" gần nghĩa với "bug"; động từ "defect" /dɪˈfekt/ lại là đào ngũ, bỏ phe.
items.explanationEn: defect /ˈdiːfekt/ (noun): a fault or flaw. In testing, defect is close to bug; the verb defect /dɪˈfekt/ means to leave one side for another.

items.question: Trong câu "This is one of the strongest project health indicators there is.", từ "indicator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is one of the strongest project health indicators there is.", what does "indicator" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a sign that shows a state
items.explanation: indicator /ˈɪndɪkeɪtər/ (danh từ): chỉ số, dấu hiệu. "Health indicator" = chỉ số sức khoẻ; cụm "key performance indicator (KPI)".
items.explanationEn: indicator /ˈɪndɪkeɪtər/ (noun): a sign that shows a state. "Health indicator" is a sign of condition; see also "key performance indicator (KPI)".

items.question: Trong câu "If at week 20 you are still changing requirements at the week-3 rate, one of three things is happening: you have not talked to the right people, the product vision is unclear, or scope is expanding uncontrolled.", từ "expand" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If at week 20 you are still changing requirements at the week-3 rate, one of three things is happening: you have not talked to the right people, the product vision is unclear, or scope is expanding uncontrolled.", what does "expand" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expand /ɪkˈspænd/ (động từ): mở rộng, phình ra. "Scope is expanding" = phạm vi đang mở rộng; "expand on" lại là giải thích thêm.
items.explanationEn: expand /ɪkˈspænd/ (verb): to grow larger. "Scope is expanding" means it grows; "expand on" means to explain in more detail.

items.question: Trong câu "If this line keeps rising, scope is inflating.", từ "inflate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If this line keeps rising, scope is inflating.", what does "inflate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: inflate /ɪnˈfleɪt/ (động từ): phình to, tăng lên. Nghĩa gốc là bơm hơi; nghĩa bóng là tăng lên quá mức, ví dụ "inflated estimates".
items.explanationEn: inflate /ɪnˈfleɪt/ (verb): to increase in size. The literal meaning is to fill with air; figuratively it means to grow too much, as in "inflated estimates".

items.question: Trong câu "Each TBD is an unresolved risk.", từ "unresolved" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each TBD is an unresolved risk.", what does "unresolved" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unresolved /ˌʌnrɪˈzɒlvd/ (tính từ): chưa được giải quyết. "Unresolved issue/risk" = vấn đề/rủi ro còn treo; động từ gốc "resolve" = giải quyết.
items.explanationEn: unresolved /ˌʌnrɪˈzɒlvd/ (adjective): not yet settled. "Unresolved issue" is one still open; the base verb is resolve.

items.question: Trong câu "How much unresolved uncertainty remains?", từ "uncertainty" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How much unresolved uncertainty remains?", what does "uncertainty" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a state of not being sure
items.explanation: uncertainty /ʌnˈsɜːtnti/ (danh từ): sự không chắc chắn. "Reduce uncertainty" = giảm sự không chắc chắn, mục tiêu của việc làm rõ yêu cầu.
items.explanationEn: uncertainty /ʌnˈsɜːtnti/ (noun): a state of not being sure. "Reduce uncertainty" is a key goal of clarifying requirements.

items.question: Trong câu "The principle: present TRENDS, not a snapshot.", từ "snapshot" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The principle: present TRENDS, not a snapshot.", what does "snapshot" (noun) mean?
options: tình trạng tại một thời điểm
items.explanation: snapshot /ˈsnæpʃɒt/ (danh từ): tình trạng tại một thời điểm. "Snapshot" nghĩa gốc là ảnh chụp nhanh; nghĩa bóng là bức tranh tại một thời điểm, ngược với "trend".
items.explanationEn: snapshot /ˈsnæpʃɒt/ (noun): the state at one moment. A snapshot is literally a quick photo; figuratively a view at one moment, as opposed to a trend.

items.question: Trong câu "Chart the number of requirements in each status week by week.", từ "chart" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Chart the number of requirements in each status week by week.", what does "chart" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to show data on a graph
items.explanation: chart /tʃɑːt/ (động từ): vẽ biểu đồ theo dõi. "Chart something over time" = vẽ biểu đồ theo thời gian; "chart a course" = vạch hướng đi.
items.explanationEn: chart /tʃɑːt/ (verb): to show data on a graph. "Chart something over time" means to graph it; "chart a course" means to plan a route.

items.question: Trong câu "Change happens for entirely legitimate reasons:", từ "legitimate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Change happens for entirely legitimate reasons:", what does "legitimate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: legitimate /lɪˈdʒɪtɪmət/ (tính từ): chính đáng, hợp lý. "A legitimate reason" = lý do chính đáng; legitimate cũng có nghĩa hợp pháp.
items.explanationEn: legitimate /lɪˈdʒɪtɪmət/ (adjective): valid and reasonable. "A legitimate reason" is a valid one; legitimate can also mean legal.

items.question: Trong câu "Technical constraints surface — what seemed feasible is not.", từ "surface" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Technical constraints surface — what seemed feasible is not.", what does "surface" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: surface /ˈsɜːfɪs/ (động từ): lộ ra, xuất hiện. Động từ "surface" = nổi lên, lộ ra: "problems surface during testing".
items.explanationEn: surface /ˈsɜːfɪs/ (verb): to appear or become known. As a verb, surface means to come to light: "problems surface during testing".

items.question: Trong câu "Whoever proposes a change usually sees only the tip:", từ "tip" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Whoever proposes a change usually sees only the tip:", what does "tip" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: tip /tɪp/ (danh từ): phần chóp, phần nhô lên. Gợi nhắc thành ngữ "the tip of the iceberg" = phần nổi của tảng băng.
items.explanationEn: tip /tɪp/ (noun): the top or visible end. This echoes the idiom "the tip of the iceberg", the small visible part of a bigger problem.

items.question: Trong câu "Design changes, possibly rippling into other components.", từ "ripple" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Design changes, possibly rippling into other components.", what does "ripple" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ripple /ˈrɪpl/ (động từ): lan toả ảnh hưởng. "Ripple into/through" = lan ra; danh từ "ripple effect" = hiệu ứng dây chuyền.
items.explanationEn: ripple /ˈrɪpl/ (verb): to spread effects outward. "Ripple into" means to spread; the noun phrase "ripple effect" means a knock-on effect.

items.question: Trong câu "Disruption cost is almost never counted, but it is very real.", từ "disruption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Disruption cost is almost never counted, but it is very real.", what does "disruption" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: disruption /dɪsˈrʌpʃən/ (danh từ): sự gián đoạn. "Disruption" là sự làm gián đoạn; động từ "disrupt"; "disruptive technology" = công nghệ đột phá.
items.explanationEn: disruption /dɪsˈrʌpʃən/ (noun): an interruption to normal work. Disruption is an interruption; verb: disrupt; "disruptive technology" changes an industry.

items.question: Trong câu "Disruption cost — the team switches context and loses momentum.", từ "momentum" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Disruption cost — the team switches context and loses momentum.", what does "momentum" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: momentum /məˈmentəm/ (danh từ): đà tiến triển. "Lose/gain momentum" = mất/lấy đà; nghĩa vật lý là động lượng.
items.explanationEn: momentum /məˈmentəm/ (noun): the force of steady progress. "Lose momentum" or "gain momentum" refers to progress; in physics it is mass times velocity.

items.question: Trong câu "This is why early discovery has enormous value — and it is the economic argument for reviews, prototypes, and incremental delivery.", từ "argument" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is why early discovery has enormous value — and it is the economic argument for reviews, prototypes, and incremental delivery.", what does "argument" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a value passed to a function
items.explanation: argument /ˈɑːɡjumənt/ (danh từ): lập luận, lý lẽ. "The argument for X" = lý lẽ ủng hộ X; trong lập trình, argument là tham số truyền vào hàm.
items.explanationEn: argument /ˈɑːɡjumənt/ (noun): a reason supporting a view. "The argument for X" is the case supporting it; in programming an argument is a value passed to a function.

items.question: Trong câu "A heavyweight process gets bypassed, and change enters through the back door.", từ "bypass" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A heavyweight process gets bypassed, and change enters through the back door.", what does "bypass" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bypass /ˈbaɪpɑːs/ (động từ): bỏ qua, đi vòng qua. "Bypass a process/check" = lách qua quy trình; cũng là danh từ "a bypass" = đường tránh.
items.explanationEn: bypass /ˈbaɪpɑːs/ (verb): to go around, avoid. "Bypass a process" means to avoid it; as a noun, a bypass is a road around a town.

items.question: Trong câu "Proportional to risk — a small change does not need the same scrutiny as a large one.", từ "scrutiny" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Proportional to risk — a small change does not need the same scrutiny as a large one.", what does "scrutiny" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scrutiny /ˈskruːtəni/ (danh từ): sự xem xét kỹ lưỡng. "Under scrutiny" = đang bị xem xét kỹ; "close scrutiny" = soi xét chặt chẽ.
items.explanationEn: scrutiny /ˈskruːtəni/ (noun): careful, detailed examination. "Under scrutiny" means being examined closely; "close scrutiny" is very careful checking.

items.question: Trong câu "One person — usually the BA — checks whether the proposal is clear, not a duplicate, and within the scope of consideration.", từ "duplicate" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One person — usually the BA — checks whether the proposal is clear, not a duplicate, and within the scope of consideration.", what does "duplicate" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: duplicate /ˈdjuːplɪkət/ (danh từ): bản trùng lặp. Danh từ /ˈdjuːplɪkət/ = bản trùng; động từ "duplicate" /ˈdjuːplɪkeɪt/ = sao chép.
items.explanationEn: duplicate /ˈdjuːplɪkət/ (noun): an identical copy. The noun /ˈdjuːplɪkət/ is a copy; the verb /ˈdjuːplɪkeɪt/ means to copy.

items.question: Trong câu "Approve, reject, defer, or request more information.", từ "defer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Approve, reject, defer, or request more information.", what does "defer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: defer /dɪˈfɜːr/ (động từ): hoãn lại. "Defer to a later release" = hoãn sang bản sau; "defer to someone" = nghe theo ai.
items.explanationEn: defer /dɪˈfɜːr/ (verb): to postpone. "Defer to a later release" means to postpone; "defer to someone" means to accept their judgment.

items.question: Trong câu "Every decision must be recorded with its rationale.", từ "rationale" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every decision must be recorded with its rationale.", what does "rationale" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: rationale /ˌræʃəˈnɑːl/ (danh từ): lý do căn bản. "The rationale behind/for a decision" = lý do đằng sau quyết định.
items.explanationEn: rationale /ˌræʃəˈnɑːl/ (noun): the underlying reasons. "The rationale behind a decision" is the reasoning that justifies it.

items.question: Trong câu "Failing to close the loop with the proposer is the common error that kills a process.", từ "close the loop" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Failing to close the loop with the proposer is the common error that kills a process.", what does "close the loop" (phrase) mean?
options: phản hồi lại cho đủ vòng
items.explanation: close the loop /kləʊz ðə luːp/ (cụm từ): phản hồi lại cho đủ vòng. "Close the loop with someone" = báo lại kết quả cho người đã gửi yêu cầu.
items.explanationEn: close the loop /kləʊz ðə luːp/ (phrase): to report back and finish. "Close the loop with someone" means to report the outcome back to them.

items.question: Trong câu "Convening a whole board to approve a typo fix is the fastest way to make everyone resent and avoid the process.", từ "convene" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Convening a whole board to approve a typo fix is the fastest way to make everyone resent and avoid the process.", what does "convene" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: convene /kənˈviːn/ (động từ): triệu tập (cuộc họp). "Convene a meeting/board" = triệu tập họp; danh từ "convention" = hội nghị.
items.explanationEn: convene /kənˈviːn/ (verb): to call people to meet. "Convene a meeting" means to bring people together; noun: convention.

items.question: Trong câu "The change control board (CCB) is the group with authority to decide on change proposals.", từ "authority" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The change control board (CCB) is the group with authority to decide on change proposals.", what does "authority" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: authority /ɔːˈθɒrəti/ (danh từ): quyền hạn. "Have the authority to do something" = có quyền làm gì; "the authorities" = nhà chức trách.
items.explanationEn: authority /ɔːˈθɒrəti/ (noun): the power to decide. "Have the authority to do something" means having the power; "the authorities" are officials.

items.question: Trong câu "A technical representative — to assess technical impact and feasibility.", từ "feasibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A technical representative — to assess technical impact and feasibility.", what does "feasibility" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: feasibility /ˌfiːzəˈbɪləti/ (danh từ): tính khả thi. "Feasibility study" = nghiên cứu khả thi; tính từ "feasible".
items.explanationEn: feasibility /ˌfiːzəˈbɪləti/ (noun): how possible something is. A "feasibility study" checks whether a plan can work; adjective: feasible.

items.question: Trong câu "Every member must be able to decide on behalf of their organization.", từ "on behalf of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every member must be able to decide on behalf of their organization.", what does "on behalf of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on behalf of /ɒn bɪˈhɑːf əv/ (cụm từ): thay mặt cho. "On behalf of the team" = thay mặt nhóm, nói hoặc quyết định với tư cách đại diện.
items.explanationEn: on behalf of /ɒn bɪˈhɑːf əv/ (phrase): representing, acting for. "On behalf of the team" means acting or speaking as its representative.

items.question: Trong câu "Meet regularly and often — weekly usually beats monthly, because it keeps the queue short.", từ "queue" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Meet regularly and often — weekly usually beats monthly, because it keeps the queue short.", what does "queue" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: queue /kjuː/ (danh từ): hàng chờ xử lý. "Keep the queue short" = giữ hàng chờ ngắn; trong lập trình, queue là hàng đợi FIFO.
items.explanationEn: queue /kjuː/ (noun): a line of items waiting. "Keep the queue short" means few items wait; in programming a queue is a FIFO structure.

items.question: Trong câu "Review proposals in batches, not one at a time.", từ "batch" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Review proposals in batches, not one at a time.", what does "batch" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: batch /bætʃ/ (danh từ): lô, nhóm (xử lý cùng lúc). "In batches" = theo từng lô; "batch processing" = xử lý theo lô.
items.explanationEn: batch /bætʃ/ (noun): a group handled together. "In batches" means in groups; "batch processing" handles many items together.

items.question: Trong câu "Looking at 10 proposals together shows you the aggregate impact — which reviewing them individually never does.", từ "aggregate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Looking at 10 proposals together shows you the aggregate impact — which reviewing them individually never does.", what does "aggregate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: aggregate /ˈæɡrɪɡət/ (tính từ): tổng hợp, gộp lại. "Aggregate impact/data" = tác động/dữ liệu tổng hợp; trong SQL có "aggregate functions" như SUM.
items.explanationEn: aggregate /ˈæɡrɪɡət/ (adjective): combined into a total. "Aggregate data" is combined data; SQL has aggregate functions such as SUM.

items.question: Trong câu "Points out when a series of small changes is accumulating into a large scope shift.", từ "accumulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Points out when a series of small changes is accumulating into a large scope shift.", what does "accumulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: accumulate /əˈkjuːmjəleɪt/ (động từ): tích tụ dần. "Accumulate" = dồn lại theo thời gian: "technical debt accumulates".
items.explanationEn: accumulate /əˈkjuːmjəleɪt/ (verb): to build up gradually. Accumulate means to build up over time: "technical debt accumulates".

items.question: Trong câu "Clarifies the proposal before it reaches the board — many proposals are too vague to evaluate.", từ "vague" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Clarifies the proposal before it reaches the board — many proposals are too vague to evaluate.", what does "vague" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: vague /veɪɡ/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, không rõ ràng. "Vague requirement" = yêu cầu mơ hồ; trái nghĩa "precise", "specific".
items.explanationEn: vague /veɪɡ/ (adjective): unclear, not precise. A "vague requirement" lacks detail; opposites are precise and specific.

items.question: Trong câu "The BA most valuable contribution: supplying the information for the board to decide WELL, not defending the baseline at all costs.", từ "at all costs" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The BA most valuable contribution: supplying the information for the board to decide WELL, not defending the baseline at all costs.", what does "at all costs" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at all costs /ət ɔːl kɒsts/ (cụm từ): bằng mọi giá. "At all costs" = bằng mọi giá, dù phải hy sinh gì; không liên quan đến tiền cụ thể.
items.explanationEn: at all costs /ət ɔːl kɒsts/ (phrase): no matter what it takes. "At all costs" means whatever the sacrifice; it is not about a literal price.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most important question — architectural change has a completely different cost profile from a local change.", từ "profile" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most important question — architectural change has a completely different cost profile from a local change.", what does "profile" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a side view of a face
items.explanation: profile /ˈprəʊfaɪl/ (danh từ): đặc điểm tổng thể. "Cost/risk profile" = đặc điểm chi phí/rủi ro; "user profile" = hồ sơ người dùng.
items.explanationEn: profile /ˈprəʊfaɪl/ (noun): the overall pattern of features. "Cost profile" or "risk profile" describes the overall pattern; "user profile" is an account page.

items.question: Trong câu "This is where tracing earns its keep.", từ "earn its keep" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is where tracing earns its keep.", what does "earn its keep" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: earn its keep /ɜːn ɪts kiːp/ (cụm từ): chứng tỏ đáng giá. "Earn its keep" = xứng đáng với công sức/chi phí bỏ ra để duy trì nó.
items.explanationEn: earn its keep /ɜːn ɪts kiːp/ (phrase): to prove worth the cost. "Earn its keep" means to be useful enough to justify its cost.

items.question: Trong câu "This is where the investment in requirements tracing pays a dividend.", từ "dividend" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is where the investment in requirements tracing pays a dividend.", what does "dividend" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dividend /ˈdɪvɪdend/ (danh từ): lợi ích thu về. "Pay dividends" = mang lại lợi ích về sau; nghĩa tài chính là cổ tức.
items.explanationEn: dividend /ˈdɪvɪdend/ (noun): a benefit gained later. "Pay dividends" means to bring benefits later; in finance it is a payment to shareholders.

items.question: Trong câu "The answer comes in minutes instead of days, and is complete instead of guesswork.", từ "guesswork" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The answer comes in minutes instead of days, and is complete instead of guesswork.", what does "guesswork" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: guesswork /ˈɡeswɜːk/ (danh từ): sự phỏng đoán. "Guesswork" mang ý tiêu cực: đoán mò thay vì dựa trên dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: guesswork /ˈɡeswɜːk/ (noun): estimating without facts. Guesswork is negative: guessing instead of relying on data.

items.question: Trong câu "An effort estimate as a range, not a single number.", từ "range" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An effort estimate as a range, not a single number.", what does "range" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: range /reɪndʒ/ (danh từ): khoảng giá trị. "Give an estimate as a range" = ước lượng dạng khoảng, ví dụ 3–5 ngày.
items.explanationEn: range /reɪndʒ/ (noun): a span between two values. "An estimate as a range" gives a low and high value, such as 3–5 days.

items.question: Trong câu "Beware the underestimation bias.", từ "bias" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Beware the underestimation bias.", what does "bias" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a tendency to lean one way
items.explanation: bias /ˈbaɪəs/ (danh từ): thiên lệch. "Underestimation bias" = xu hướng ước lượng thấp; "confirmation bias" = thiên kiến xác nhận.
items.explanationEn: bias /ˈbaɪəs/ (noun): a tendency to lean one way. "Underestimation bias" is a tendency to estimate too low; see also "confirmation bias".

items.question: Trong câu "Scope creep is the gradual, uncontrolled expansion of project scope through many small changes, each of which looks reasonable on its own.", từ "gradual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scope creep is the gradual, uncontrolled expansion of project scope through many small changes, each of which looks reasonable on its own.", what does "gradual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: gradual /ˈɡrædʒuəl/ (tính từ): dần dần, từ từ. "Gradual" trái nghĩa "sudden"; trạng từ "gradually".
items.explanationEn: gradual /ˈɡrædʒuəl/ (adjective): happening slowly over time. Gradual is the opposite of sudden; adverb: gradually.

items.question: Trong câu "Origin analysis is very revealing.", từ "revealing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Origin analysis is very revealing.", what does "revealing" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: revealing /rɪˈviːlɪŋ/ (tính từ): cho thấy nhiều điều. "Very revealing" = tiết lộ nhiều điều đáng chú ý; động từ "reveal".
items.explanationEn: revealing /rɪˈviːlɪŋ/ (adjective): showing useful information. "Very revealing" means it exposes a lot; verb: reveal.

items.question: Trong câu "If 60 percent of changes come from one stakeholder, that person probably was not adequately involved during initial elicitation.", từ "adequately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If 60 percent of changes come from one stakeholder, that person probably was not adequately involved during initial elicitation.", what does "adequately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: adequately /ˈædɪkwətli/ (trạng từ): một cách đầy đủ. "Adequately involved/tested" = được tham gia/kiểm thử đủ mức cần thiết.
items.explanationEn: adequately /ˈædɪkwətli/ (adverb): sufficiently, enough. "Adequately tested" means tested enough for the purpose.

items.question: Trong câu "This classification turns change data into PROCESS IMPROVEMENT.", từ "classification" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This classification turns change data into PROCESS IMPROVEMENT.", what does "classification" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: classification /ˌklæsɪfɪˈkeɪʃən/ (danh từ): sự phân loại. "Classification" = phân loại theo nhóm; "classified" lại có nghĩa là tài liệu mật.
items.explanationEn: classification /ˌklæsɪfɪˈkeɪʃən/ (noun): putting into groups. Classification means sorting into groups; "classified" can also mean secret.

items.question: Trong câu "The business genuinely changed → entirely legitimate, nobody is at fault.", từ "at fault" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The business genuinely changed → entirely legitimate, nobody is at fault.", what does "at fault" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at fault /ət fɔːlt/ (cụm từ): có lỗi, chịu trách nhiệm. "Be at fault" = là người có lỗi; ví dụ "nobody is at fault" = không ai có lỗi.
items.explanationEn: at fault /ət fɔːlt/ (phrase): to blame for a problem. "Be at fault" means to be responsible for a mistake.

items.question: Trong câu "The team is expected to absorb every change without any schedule adjustment.", từ "absorb" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The team is expected to absorb every change without any schedule adjustment.", what does "absorb" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to take on without extra help
items.explanation: absorb /əbˈzɔːb/ (động từ): gánh chịu, tự xoay xở. "Absorb the cost/change" = tự gánh chi phí/thay đổi mà không được bù thêm nguồn lực.
items.explanationEn: absorb /əbˈzɔːb/ (verb): to take on without extra help. "Absorb the cost" means to take it on without extra resources.

items.question: Trong câu "This is really not a change problem — it is a problem of refusing to acknowledge the consequences of change.", từ "acknowledge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is really not a change problem — it is a problem of refusing to acknowledge the consequences of change.", what does "acknowledge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: acknowledge /əkˈnɒlɪdʒ/ (động từ): thừa nhận. "Acknowledge the consequences" = thừa nhận hệ quả; trong mạng, ACK = xác nhận đã nhận.
items.explanationEn: acknowledge /əkˈnɒlɪdʒ/ (verb): to accept as true. "Acknowledge the consequences" means to accept them; in networking, ACK confirms receipt.

items.question: Trong câu "The clearest sign of scope creep: workload increases but schedule and resources do not.", từ "workload" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The clearest sign of scope creep: workload increases but schedule and resources do not.", what does "workload" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the amount of work to do
items.explanation: workload /ˈwɜːkləʊd/ (danh từ): khối lượng công việc. "Heavy workload" = khối lượng việc nặng; trong hạ tầng, workload là tác vụ chạy trên hệ thống.
items.explanationEn: workload /ˈwɜːkləʊd/ (noun): the amount of work to do. "Heavy workload" means lots of work; in infrastructure, a workload is software running on a system.

items.question: Trong câu "Rejecting a change is routine.", từ "routine" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rejecting a change is routine.", what does "routine" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: routine /ruːˈtiːn/ (tính từ): bình thường, thường lệ. "Routine" tính từ = thường lệ; danh từ "a daily routine" = thói quen hằng ngày.
items.explanationEn: routine /ruːˈtiːn/ (adjective): normal and regular. As an adjective routine means ordinary; as a noun, "a daily routine" is a regular habit.

items.question: Trong câu "If every proposal gets approved, the board is not really deciding — it is rubber-stamping.", từ "rubber-stamp" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If every proposal gets approved, the board is not really deciding — it is rubber-stamping.", what does "rubber-stamp" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to mark with an ink stamp
items.explanation: rubber-stamp /ˌrʌbə ˈstæmp/ (động từ): phê duyệt chiếu lệ. "Rubber-stamp a decision" = duyệt cho có, không thực sự xem xét.
items.explanationEn: rubber-stamp /ˌrʌbə ˈstæmp/ (verb): to approve without thinking. "Rubber-stamp a decision" means to approve it automatically without real review.

items.question: Trong câu "There is no free lunch, and pretending there is destroys trust.", từ "free lunch" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There is no free lunch, and pretending there is destroys trust.", what does "free lunch" (phrase) mean?
options: thứ có được mà không tốn gì
items.explanation: free lunch /friː lʌntʃ/ (cụm từ): thứ có được mà không tốn gì. Thành ngữ "there is no free lunch" = không có gì miễn phí, mọi thứ đều có cái giá.
items.explanationEn: free lunch /friː lʌntʃ/ (phrase): something gained at no cost. The idiom "there is no free lunch" means everything has a cost.

items.question: Trong câu "Too rigid → the project delivers exactly what was specified 18 months ago, but that is no longer what the organization needs.", từ "rigid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Too rigid → the project delivers exactly what was specified 18 months ago, but that is no longer what the organization needs.", what does "rigid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: rigid /ˈrɪdʒɪd/ (tính từ): cứng nhắc. "Rigid process" = quy trình cứng nhắc; trái nghĩa "flexible".
items.explanationEn: rigid /ˈrɪdʒɪd/ (adjective): inflexible in rules. A "rigid process" does not adapt; opposite: flexible.

items.question: Trong câu "You succeed procedurally and fail substantively.", từ "substantively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You succeed procedurally and fail substantively.", what does "substantively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: substantively /səbˈstæntɪvli/ (trạng từ): về mặt thực chất. "Substantively" đối lập với "procedurally": đúng quy trình nhưng sai về thực chất.
items.explanationEn: substantively /səbˈstæntɪvli/ (adverb): in real, essential terms. Substantively contrasts with procedurally: correct in process but wrong in substance.

items.question: Trong câu "The team burns out, trust erodes, and nobody believes any commitment any more.", từ "erode" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The team burns out, trust erodes, and nobody believes any commitment any more.", what does "erode" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to wear away rock or soil
items.explanation: erode /ɪˈrəʊd/ (động từ): suy giảm dần. "Trust erodes" = niềm tin mai một dần; nghĩa gốc là xói mòn đất đá.
items.explanationEn: erode /ɪˈrəʊd/ (verb): to weaken gradually. "Trust erodes" means it weakens slowly; literally erode describes rock wearing away.

items.question: Trong câu "The team burns out, trust erodes, and nobody believes any commitment any more.", từ "burn out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The team burns out, trust erodes, and nobody believes any commitment any more.", what does "burn out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: burn out /bɜːn aʊt/ (cụm từ): kiệt sức vì làm việc. "Burn out" = kiệt sức do áp lực kéo dài; danh từ "burnout".
items.explanationEn: burn out /bɜːn aʊt/ (phrase): to be exhausted by work. "Burn out" means to become exhausted from long stress; noun: burnout.

items.question: Trong câu "Attributes and status give you visibility.", từ "visibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Attributes and status give you visibility.", what does "visibility" (noun) mean?
options: khả năng nắm rõ tình hình
items.explanation: visibility /ˌvɪzəˈbɪləti/ (danh từ): khả năng nắm rõ tình hình. "Give visibility into progress" = giúp thấy rõ tiến độ; nghĩa gốc là tầm nhìn.
items.explanationEn: visibility /ˌvɪzəˈbɪləti/ (noun): clear insight into status. "Visibility into progress" means being able to see it clearly; literally it is how far you can see.

items.question: Trong câu "Change is normal, not failure — the goal is deliberate change, not no change.", từ "deliberate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Change is normal, not failure — the goal is deliberate change, not no change.", what does "deliberate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: deliberate /dɪˈlɪbərət/ (tính từ): có chủ đích. "Deliberate" (tính từ) /dɪˈlɪbərət/ = có chủ đích; động từ /dɪˈlɪbəreɪt/ = cân nhắc.
items.explanationEn: deliberate /dɪˈlɪbərət/ (adjective): done on purpose. The adjective /dɪˈlɪbərət/ means intentional; the verb /dɪˈlɪbəreɪt/ means to think carefully.

items.question: Trong câu "The change control process must be simple, fast, transparent, and proportional to risk — otherwise it gets bypassed.", từ "proportional" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The change control process must be simple, fast, transparent, and proportional to risk — otherwise it gets bypassed.", what does "proportional" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: proportional /prəˈpɔːʃənl/ (tính từ): tương xứng với. "Proportional to risk" = mức độ tương xứng với rủi ro.
items.explanationEn: proportional /prəˈpɔːʃənl/ (adjective): in suitable relation to. "Proportional to risk" means sized according to the risk.

items.question: Trong câu "Scope creep is more dangerous than one large change because it is never examined as a whole.", từ "as a whole" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scope creep is more dangerous than one large change because it is never examined as a whole.", what does "as a whole" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: as a whole /əz ə həʊl/ (cụm từ): tổng thể, gộp chung. "As a whole" = xét tổng thể, không tách từng phần.
items.explanationEn: as a whole /əz ə həʊl/ (phrase): all together, overall. "As a whole" means considered all together rather than in parts.

items.question: Trong câu "If 60 percent of changes come from one stakeholder, that person was not adequately involved during elicitation.", từ "stakeholder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If 60 percent of changes come from one stakeholder, that person was not adequately involved during elicitation.", what does "stakeholder" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkhəʊldər/ (danh từ): bên liên quan. "Stakeholder" = người có quyền lợi hoặc chịu ảnh hưởng từ dự án.
items.explanationEn: stakeholder /ˈsteɪkhəʊldər/ (noun): a person with an interest. A stakeholder is anyone with an interest in or affected by the project.

items.question: Trong câu "Status tracking gives a meaningful picture of progress that gut-feel percentages never can.", từ "gut feel" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Status tracking gives a meaningful picture of progress that gut-feel percentages never can.", what does "gut feel" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: gut feel /ɡʌt fiːl/ (danh từ): cảm tính, linh cảm. "Gut feel/gut feeling" = cảm giác trực giác, không dựa trên dữ liệu.
items.explanationEn: gut feel /ɡʌt fiːl/ (noun): intuition, not data. "Gut feel" or "gut feeling" is intuition rather than evidence.
